title: Three-part triage gate: access-tier + license + re-identification (blocking)
context: Before any Ewing dataset is documented it must clear a non-skippable, fixed-order blocking gate: access-tier, then license, then re-identification risk. This protects the catalog's scope of only open-access, aggregate, de-identified data and keeps controlled-access and individual-level data out. The gate emits a committed PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE artifact per dataset. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Specify and publish the three-part triage gate (access-tier, license, re-identification) with a committed per-dataset PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE artifact format and the inspection access protocol.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate runs in fixed order, all blocking: (a) access-tier — PASS only if positively confirmed open-access with a cited evidenceUrl; controlled-access (dbGaP/EGA/DACO/TARGET-controlled/individual biobank) = immediate EXCLUDE; unconfirmable = EXCLUDE.

(b) license — PASS only if permitsDerivatives: true is set from a cited clause/URL; missing/unparseable/NC-reference-DB/embargoed = FLAG/EXCLUDE (no default-allow); defers NC/DUA/share-alike cases to policy-004.

(c) re-identification — applies the methodology: germline-variant-level data EXCLUDED; k<5 small-cell flag; geo/linkage checks; aggregate-only confirmed. Any flag = EXCLUDE/FLAG unless publisher-documented aggregation meets thresholds; we never re-identify or anonymize.
Inspection during triage follows the access protocol (metadata/header reads, open tier only, aggregate only, local/ephemeral, no committed individual-level data; halt on any signal).
Produces a committed, reviewable PASS/FLAG/EXCLUDE artifact per dataset recording which checks ran and what fired, plus the completeness before-score.
